recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: two federated protocols whispering across the open web
encrypted mail servers flickering somewhere in europe
code written for the stranger who inherits it tomorrow
typhoon winds gathering off the philippines coast
karl the fog holding san francisco at thirteen degrees in midsummer
stutter-house pulses drifting through overcast july air

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap stutter-house snare hits as they cascade down foggy lanes — each miss spawns another ghost drummer doubling the beat.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: tap descending pulse markers in time
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: nailing one perfect 8-bar loop triggers a drop and clears the fog for a second
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM climbs, lanes multiply, off-beat ghost notes crowd the grid
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon waveform bleeding through gray san francisco fog

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Draw maintenance paths through tangled legacy code — your line must reach the human who inherits the repo without crossing dead imports.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: draw a continuous path connecting nodes
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: drag to sketch routes between module nodes
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: each completed refactor chain unlocks the next file in the dependency tree
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: tangled nodes spawn faster and drawn paths decay if held too long

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Sort drifting ActivityPub and ATProto envelopes into the right federation slots before the relay queue backs up and drops packets.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.mechanic: lane-switch sorting on falling message tiles
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: swipe left or right to route each envelope
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: clearing a batch syncs a tiny fediverse constellation that pulses once
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: mixed-protocol packets arrive faster with decoy headers and split envelopes
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: retro terminal green on cork bulletin board

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick lifeboats through typhoon swells to rescue stranded signal flares — each rescue adds weight and changes your arc.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: flick-and-hold to gauge launch angle, release to launch
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: rescue count stacks into a 60-second evacuation tally with combo multipliers
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: wave height and crosswinds intensify, debris blocks clean arcs
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: watercolor storm clouds over a distant coastline
